Rishi / Priyom — heads-up: Susan just flagged a board meeting that will prevent her in-person attendance for the 9:00 kickoff. Also reports of weather-related flight delays into DFW; Tom is stuck on a tarmac hold.

Options I think we should consider (quick):
- Proceed as planned onsite, have Susan call in for the 9:00 exec kickoff — requires room A/V check + dial-in setup.
- Offer to reschedule the executive session to Wed, Mar 16 (same agenda) — customer asked for this as an option.
- If we reschedule, coordinate with travel ops on flight/hotel cancellation windows (hotel penalty? airline change fees). Katie is looped here to give us exact cutoff/tariffs.
- Offer a partial credit on the delivery fee if the exec session is pushed out (negotiation lever).

Immediate asks:
1) Rishi — can you advise on commercial flexibility? What's our standard for same-week reschedules for executive workshops? Any precedent to offer a $X credit?
2) Priyom — can you confirm whether engineering is OK to run the hands-on workshop without the exec-level kickoff? We can split teams, but we need a decision in the next hour to cancel hotel rooms if needed.
3) Katie — please confirm airline change fees and hotel penalty windows for the current bookings. If flights are delayed >3 hours due to weather, can travel ops waive change fees?

I'll draft an outbound note to Susan proposing a hybrid fallback + two alternate dates and offer to cover reasonable change fees.

— Marissa

Susan — thanks for flagging and sorry about the disruption. We have three pragmatic options and a proposal to minimize wasted travel spend:

1) Hybrid kickoff (recommended): Run the 9:00AM exec kickoff as scheduled with Tom / your CIO in the room and have you join via Zoom for the first hour. Our team will ensure room A/V is set up and a strong UX for remote participation. We can still run the afternoon hands-on workshop as planned.

2) Reschedule the exec portion: Move the executive session to Wed, Mar 16 (same agenda). We can keep the afternoon workshop on Mar 11 if your infra team is available; otherwise we can shift the full day. If rescheduling, Redwood will cover standard airline change fees and the hotel penalty up to $250 per person (for this instance) — Katie, please confirm actuals and we'll reimburse.

3) Full virtual exec session: Run the executive kickoff fully virtual on the original day and keep the in-person workshop for your engineers another day.

We don't want penalties to drive a bad outcome here — happy to absorb reasonable change fees given the board conflict and storm delays. Please confirm your preference and whether Tom will be onsite for the morning. If you choose reschedule, suggest two date options: Wed 2026-03-16 or Thu 2026-03-18.

Attached: updated-agenda-hybrid.pdf (marks areas that can be run virtually). Also linking the HubSpot record for the deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/COREH/record/78421

If you prefer, we can also do a quick 10-minute call this afternoon to decide.

Thanks — and safe travels to Tom.
